MSI Center for Windows, ported to Linux for the **MSI Crosshair 16 HX D14VFKG (MS-15P2)**.

### Pre-installation requirements

- **Hardware:** MSI Crosshair 16 HX D14V (`MS-15P2`), 24-zone per-key RGB keyboard, EC `15P2EMS1.110` — developed and hardware-verified against this exact configuration
- **[`msi-ec`](https://github.com/BeardOverflow/msi-ec) kernel driver** — platform modes, battery charge limits, fan modes, webcam/Fn switches
- **[`msi_wmi_platform`](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/master/drivers/platform/x86/msi-wmi-platform.c) + debugfs** — custom fan curves (WMI2 tables)
- **[`ec_sys`](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/master/drivers/acpi/ec_sys.c) with `write_support=1`** — advanced fan mode
- **[`wheel`](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/Users_and_groups#Group_management) group membership** — daemon RPC access
- **[hidraw](https://docs.kernel.org/hid/hidraw.html) access to the keyboard** — RGB control (udev rule, installed automatically)
- **[Python 3.10+](https://www.python.org/) with [PyGObject](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/pygobject), [GTK 4](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/gtk), [libadwaita](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libadwaita)** — the GUI
- Optional: **[`nvidia-smi`](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/drivers/unix/)** — GPU temps/usage in the overview

Full checklist with self-check commands: [README → Requirements](https://github.com/Krishna0607/Mystic-Center#requirements).

### Install

**Arch Linux** — prebuilt package attached below:

```bash
sudo pacman -U mystic-center-1.0.0-1-any.pkg.tar.zst
sudo systemctl enable --now mystic-center.service
```

Log out and back in once so the udev ACL grants your session access to the keyboard.

**Any distro** — from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Krishna0607/Mystic-Center.git
cd Mystic-Center
./install.sh
sudo ./install.sh --system
```

Package checksum: see `sha256sums.txt` below.

Verified on real hardware (CachyOS, kernel 7.2.x).
